race.comment: PUFFIN (11) showed good pace over this trip at Gunnedah last time and defied all challengers to score by 4 lengths. Should enjoy a good run just off the speed. Is drawn to advantage and can make it two on the bounce. SORRENTO PALACE (6) is mixing her form but ran a better race to finish fourth last time out over 1200m at Warren after being prominent at the bend. Suitably placed so anticipating a big run this time. DENMAN FORCE (1) was thereabouts fresh when resuming off a short break. Is sure to have come on from that and gets some weight off with the claim. Can give this a shake. THE CONTRACTOR (4) returns and while he doesn't win out of turn, his best form stacks up. Not overlooking.
